answer.rationale: Objective forbids raising delivery risk: line is at 94% with no buffer and the primary contract dies in 14 days without auto-renew, so deferral is unsafe (c5 applied only to a non-critical month-to-month case) and a primary cutover would put scheduled volume at risk even if c2 found onboarding quick last year. Renewing as-is (c1) protects continuity but misses the 18% mandate. Intend to benchmark the incumbent against the low-cost quote and renegotiate price/terms (c4) so cost can move without a vendor change. Unverified whether renegotiation can actually reach 18%; that magnitude is not in memory, so c4 is the one record to pull.
